hypothesis: 在同一条训练 trajectory 上维护 decay=0.999 的 EMA；相对于 concurrent online control，EMA 在真正 fresh、episode-disjoint 且包含 early/middle/late temporal anchors 的 predictor evaluation 上保持或改善 ranking fidelity。

design.architecture: LeWMCompactRecurrentTransitionStudent h256 shared recurrent no attention no conditioner
design.objective: unchanged horizon-weighted free-running latent MSE + 0.1 * context-normalized teacher-score SmoothL1 mean over contexts

training.ema_initialization: clone shared step-0 online state before optimizer step 1
training.ema_update: after every optimizer step: ema = 0.999 * ema + 0.001 * online

fresh_evaluation.selection_algorithm: shuffle valid episode IDs once; old heldout=valid[:8]; old train=valid[8:520]; fresh=valid[520:528]

anchors.validity: current frame at anchor, actions anchor..anchor+24, goal frame anchor+25 all within the same episode

fresh_evaluation.nested_structure: episode -> anchor stratum -> action-prefix seed block; episode is replicate
fresh_evaluation.rows_and_targets: generated on PBS compute node only; not returned
fresh_evaluation.train_bank_reuse: Phase 2 formal 512 prepared rows reused verbatim

evaluation.latency_boundary: cached official H=1 latent plus five packed action tokens through five-step predictor; excludes encoder/CEM/environment

stratum_protection.role: protect each temporal stratum from being hidden by the overall median; overall minimum thresholds remain only at the inherited overall gate

ema_mechanism_secondary.paired_unit: episode after median over its six anchor x seed blocks
ema_mechanism_secondary.joint_rule: episode counts if EMA improves Spearman with top30 non-worse OR improves top30 with Spearman non-worse; ties are non-worse but neither metric improvement alone is sufficient

gates.primary: EMA terminal step 3000 must pass overall inherited absolute gate and early/middle/late stratum protection gate; online is concurrent descriptive control; mechanism comparison is secondary only
